title: Fix the touch credit
prompt: This report counts how often each campaign was a customer's first touch and last touch before converting. Campaigns that were never first or never last show a blank instead of 0. Find the bug and fix `solve(attribution_events)`.
rules: A touch is a first touch when `position` is 1, and a last touch when `position` equals `touches_in_path`. A path with one touch is both.
`first_touches` and `last_touches` count those touches per campaign and are 0, never missing, when there are none.
Every campaign in `attribution_events` gets a row. Return `campaign_id`, `first_touches` and `last_touches`.
hints: Look at a campaign whose touches are all in the middle of a path, or never the last one.
`F.when(cond, 1)` without `otherwise` is missing on every other row, and the sum of only missing values is missing.
Add `.otherwise(0)` to both `when`s, or count matches with `F.count(F.when(cond, True))`.
explanation: Both `when`s lack an `otherwise`, so rows that don't match are missing, and a campaign with no match at all sums to missing instead of 0. Add `.otherwise(0)`: `F.sum(F.when(first, 1).otherwise(0))` and the same for `last`. `F.count(F.when(first, True))` is an equally good fix, because `count` skips missing values and returns 0 for none. `F.count(F.when(first, 1).otherwise(0))` is not: with `otherwise` every row has a value, so it counts every touch. Filtering to first touches before grouping would drop campaigns that never were first.
